messages:
maya: Need a concise GA clearance checklist: SLA wording, docs parity (Hosted/Dedicated/Private), oncall coverage, monitoring/runbooks, pricing/burst guardrails. Who's owning what?
chris: I will draft SLA + run perf validation. Proposal: 99.9% monthly availability (hosted control plane). Per-tenant measurement for Dedicated/Private, global for Hosted. Will post perf sweep results.
sasha: I'll own monitoring & runbooks. Drafting dashboards: errors, latency buckets, token burn. Propose paging on error-rate >5% for 5m or token burn anomaly >2x baseline for 10m. Need eng error taxonomy.
andrew: Pricing lead 1: sketching three tiers: dev free credits, standard metered, committed reserved with discount + optional burst-backstop for spikes. Need anonymized 95th pct token profiles.
elaine: Docs: API quickstart, SLA page, Dedicated/Private migration notes, Private KMS/audit appendix. Will add curl healthchecks and examples. ETA: first pass tomorrow AM.
oncall-bot: Reminder: maintenance window Sat 02:00-03:00 UTC will be excluded from SLA.
maya: Decision: GA pages = SEV2 for sustained partial degradation (>5% customers) or inability to accept new requests for >3m; SEV1 for region outage.
chris: Action: perf sweep tonight; will upload artifacts and cold-start memory numbers.
sasha: Action: PR for runbook and alerts.
andrew: Action: price model + burst cost offsets.
elaine: Action: docs draft + coordinate with security on KMS/audit retention.
maya: Sync at 16:00 UTC to confirm EOD items. Drop PRs/dashboards here before the sync. If all green I'll add signoff and notify legal/sales. :white_check_mark:
